content.comment_body: Hello, I'm facing a new issue and would appreciate some assistance. I created a function block program using [product_name] version [version_no] and downloaded it to a [product_name] device. Initially, I had connectivity problems, but eventually the program transferred successfully. When I tried to modify and reload the program, the software requested a password for the first time. I entered 'LOGO' as the password and found that the program loaded extremely slowly. Upon starting the device, it did not work properly. Live monitoring partially loaded and then froze. Reverting to the previous version resulted in the same issue, and now nothing functions as expected. Any suggestions?

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Diagnosing issues like this remotely can be challenging. Your description suggests there may be a problematic Ethernet connection. Please provide more details: - Which exact [product_name] are you using? Please share the complete [article_no] and firmware version. - What are the IP address and subnet mask for your PC? - What are the IP address and subnet mask for your [product_name]? - Is your PC connected directly to the [product_name]? - Or is it connected through a router? - Are you connecting via LAN or WiFi?

Thank you for your reply. Your suggestion regarding communication errors prompted me to thoroughly recheck everything. I discovered the issue was a worn RJ45 port on my laptop. After switching to a USB-to-Ethernet adapter, everything worked correctly. The unusual symptoms initially misled me, so I ended up overthinking the problem. Many thanks, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users discussed difficulties with program transfer and modification using [product_name] with [version_no], encountering unexpected password requests, slow performance, and freezing during live monitoring. Initial suspicions included possible software or hardware faults, but after further investigation, a physical issue with the laptop’s RJ45 Ethernet port was found responsible for unreliable communication.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects dependable program transfer, normal download speeds, and stable monitoring functions, without sudden requests for passwords or system freezes.
